meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你在一个 DM 渠道上建好第一个 NanoClaw agent：确认你在该渠道的用户身份、把私信消息群与新 agent 接起来，并让 agent 走正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信。技能可重复运行。
howto.when: 在渠道凭据已配置、服务正在运行，且至少装好一个 /add-<channel> 渠道适配器并已连接之后使用。

say.text: 帮我在 Discord 上初始化第一个 agent
say.note: 它会依次问你渠道、用户 ID 和显示名

say.text: 我的 Telegram 用户 ID 是 xxx，显示名是 Alex
say.note: 用于解析私信会话并建好 agent 与消息群

say.text: 欢迎私信一直没到，帮我查一下
say.note: 它会用数据库排查未送达的消息

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: resolve your channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and have the agent send a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Safe to rerun.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, and after at least one /add-<channel> adapter is installed and connected.

say_en.text: Set up my first agent on Discord
say_en.note: It will ask for channel, user ID, and name

say_en.text: My Telegram user ID is xxx, display name Alex
say_en.note: Used to resolve the DM chat and create the agent

say_en.text: The welcome DM never arrived, help me check
say_en.note: It diagnoses delivery via the database
